integrity: The theorem is proved by exact spectral identities and an analytic all-orders bound; the supplied checker provides additional finite diagnostic tests. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only the half-benchmark dichotomy is resolved; optimal constants for cycles with at least five vertices and arbitrary graph-weight extensions are not claimed. A complete full-text comparison to one older graph-functionals paper and independent audit remain outstanding.
title: A cubic spectral obstruction and the exact heat square-function boundary on finite cycles
